# ThumbnailCache

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/SceneBuilder/AssetSources/ThumbnailCache.cs#L15)

Card pictures for entries that are not in the project yet, fetched once and kept under
Library/ so reopening the window is free. Requests are fire and forget: the first call for
an entry starts the download and returns null, and [`NotifyChanged()`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/AssetSources#notifychanged)
brings the window back once the image is on disk.
Shared by every [`IAssetThumbnailSource`](/api/vrframework-core-editors-scenebuilding/IAssetThumbnailSource); each one gets its own folder so two
databases cannot collide on an entry id.

## Methods

### Clear() {#clear}

Forgets every loaded picture, so the next request reads from disk again. Failures are
forgotten too - a refresh is exactly when a picture that could not be fetched deserves
another go.

### Get(string, string) {#get-string-string}

The picture for an entry, downloading it on first request. Returns null until the
download finishes; the window polls, so the card fills in by itself.
